name: Podcast guest invite
description: Books guests for a show. Names the specific episode idea rather than asking "would you like to come on", because a concrete topic is far easier to say yes to than an open invitation.
audience: Practitioners with a specific, unusual, defensible opinion — not the professional-guest circuit.

variants: {{firstName|Hi}} — I host a show for {{title|people in your field}} and you keep saying things nobody else in the space will say. Connecting with an episode in mind.
Hi {{firstName|there}} — I run a podcast in your area and have a specific episode I'd like to build around your work at {{company|your company}}. Happy to connect first.

Thanks {{firstName|there}}. The episode I want to make: why the standard advice in your field is wrong, argued by someone who has actually done it. Forty-five minutes, remote, we do the editing. Interested?
Here's the pitch, {{firstName|there}}: one episode, one argument — the thing you believe that your peers don't. Forty-five minutes, remote, we handle everything else.
{{firstName|Hi}} — happy to send the outline and a couple of past episodes so you can see the format before committing to anything.
No commitment needed yet, {{firstName|there}} — want the running order and two sample episodes to judge it by?
I'll leave the invitation open, {{firstName|there}} — no expiry. Come back whenever the diary allows.
Standing invitation, {{firstName|there}}. I'll stop asking; the seat stays free.
